pcs.pc_description: fill measured volume of milk into container/steam jacketed kettle/silos/evaporator
set controls of steam jacketed kettle/silos/evaporator to stir milk until moisture evaporates upto desired moisture level; controls: temperature, pressure, agitator speed, time etc.
check the consistency of evaporated milk (khoya)and continue stirring till a concentration of 50% of total solids is attained

transfer khoya into container to storage room and ensure desired temperature is maintained till further processing between stones/plates to achieve required fineness, collect the milled material (flour/powder) from the discharge outlet
measure the amount of sugar and water required
transfer measured quantity of mixture into steam jacketed kettle/silos
• controls the parameters of the steam jacketed kettle • parameters: speed, temperature pressure, time etc.
check the soluble sugar content with refractometer after the syrup is formed as per the composition required
ensure the transfer of sugar syrup at optimum temperature to avoid crystallisation for further processing
clean, sort and grind the available raw material; Raw materials: besan flour, cashew/almond batter, maida, ghee/oil, nuts etc.
transfer the prepared material (khoya) and other raw materials (maida) into the container for kneading it manually or in a kneader and set the speed of the stirrer to mix the ingredients evenly
mix the ground ingredients with the kneaded raw material
load dough in feed hopper of continuous snack making machine/extruder and adjust controls to set speed of the conveyors, dough cutter to cut dough into specified weight
cut the product as per the desired shape and size or transfer the material into a moulder prior to cutting
transfer measured quantity of oil into the fryer and set controls of fryer such as temperature and level of oil etc.
add shaped balls into heated oil to fry, stir continuously and ensure not to under fry or over fry
follow company norms for reusing/discard the excess oil/used oil respectively
check the desired parameters of the product parameters: appearance, texture, taste, oil absorbing capacity, etc.
add the products into the cooking vat containing sugar syrup
• ensure cooking meets the required consistency and check the physical parameters of the product • Parameters: colour, texture, sweetness,soaking capacity, etc.
transfer product into cooling station
set the parameters of the cooling station to cool the products
pack the sample product using appropriate packaging material and transfer to lab for quality analysis
• measure specified quantity of raw materials and ingredients • Raw materials: flour, salt, spice powder, etc.
set the speed of the dough mixer and feed the dough with ground ingredients to mix uniformly
• transfer the mixture in the hopper of sheeting machine and set the parameters • Parameters: speed, temperature, time, etc
• set the parameters of the extruder and transfer the raw material into the extruder • Parameters: temperature, pressure, RPM, etc.
• collect the extruded products from the extruder and perform further processing depending on the product requirement • Requirement: frying, baking, etc Requirement: frying, baking, etc.
add sliced vegetable/extruded or shaped dough into the oil and maintain the temperature as per the product requirement during frying
transfer weighed product into the drum of blender machine to blend with desired amount of seasonings
check for presence of metallic substances in the products using organisational practices
• check the physical parameters of the product for any variation • Physical parameters: dimension, appearance, texture, taste, etc.
take samples as per specified amounts and handover to quality lab for testing
feed flattened cans into can forming machine and operate machine to form cans
set the parameters of filling machine Parameters: weight and volume
feed product and sugar syrup in the filling machine
operate seaming machine to expel air during retorting and seal filled cans
• set the parameters of retort machine to sterilize the canned products • Parameters: pressure, time, temperature, etc.
prepare the cooling tunnel to cool the cans
• set control parameters of the drying tunnel to dry the cooled cans • Parameters: temperature, air flow and conveyor speed
store the products maintaining storage conditions following SOP

verify documents and track from finished product to ingredients, in case of quality concerns and for quality management system audits
